content.title: KB Home: Fiscal Q4 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: LOS ANGELES (AP) — KB Home (KBH) on Thursday reported fiscal fourth-quarter earnings of $101.5 million. The Los Angeles-based company said it had net income of $1.55 per share. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring costs, came to $1.92 per share.

content.summary: Homebuilder KB Home (NYSE:KBH) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q4 CY2025, but sales fell by 15.3% year on year to $1.69 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.92 per share was 7.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
